findings.basis: Key read; no single value. The 15 values in this round come from AOSP CarrierConfig, Google CarrierSettings, Samsung stock config and OEM vendor overlays.
findings.effect: Parsing: ImsPhoneCallTracker reads each 'FROM|MESSAGE|TO' entry (ImsPhoneCallTracker.java:2022-2061). FROM is an ImsReasonInfo code, not a raw SIP status. '*' as FROM matches by message only and needs a non-empty message (3263). An empty MESSAGE ('332||338') matches every message for that code, because the ArrayMap lookup calls key.equals(stored) and the lower-cased actual message only has to start with the stored text (1211-1250, 3243-3291; ArrayMap.java:140-176). Use: maybeRemapReasonCode feeds only getDisconnectCauseFromReasonInfo (3298-3485), the precise cause (3488-3491) and two metrics calls (3612-3618, 3779-3783). Every redial decision reads the raw, unmapped ImsReasonInfo: CS retry on CODE_LOCAL_CALL_CS_RETRY_REQUIRED (3625-3683), alternate emergency 1514 and the Wi-Fi E911 auto retry (3791-3816), RTT-off retry 3001 (3817-3820), the reasonInfo stored by conn.setImsReasonInfo (3635, 3789) that TelephonyConnection and maybeReselectDomain hand to domain selection (TelephonyConnection.java:2575-2611; TelephonyConnectionService.java:3103-3118), EmergencyCallDomainSelector's retry-code list and TEMP/PERM switch (EmergencyCallDomainSelector.java:561-577, 1829-1835) and NormalCallDomainSelector's CS redial (NormalCallDomainSelector.java:334-350), which covers WPS, TTY and RTT calls. The mapped code reaches emergency handling through four doors only: (1) the non-domain-selection path redials on another slot only for DisconnectCause EMERGENCY_TEMP_FAILURE or EMERGENCY_PERM_FAILURE (from codes 363/364) (TelephonyConnection.java:2615-2626); (2) maybeReselectDomainForEmergencyCall skips reselection when the DisconnectCause is LOCAL (from 501) or POWER_OFF (from 111/1500) (TelephonyConnectionService.java:3131-3146); (3) ImsPhoneConnection.onDisconnect lets INCOMING_REJECTED (from 143, 1017, 1404) replace the LOCAL that a user hang-up set (ImsPhoneConnection.java:555-566), which feeds door 2; (4) EmergencyCallDomainSelector.getDisconnectCause starts from the mapped precise cause (its TEMP/PERM switch reads the raw code, and the IMS map gives IMS_EMERGENCY_TEMP/PERM 1342/1343, not the 325/326 it tests) and ends selection on NO_VALID_SIM, which the map gives for code 1501 (445-470, 561-577, 1819-1845). Everything else the mapped code changes is shown or logged: Telecom code, label, description and tone (DisconnectCauseUtil.java:138-262), call-log type and missed-call notification (CallLogManager.java:160-176; ImsPhoneCallTracker.java:3736-3758), metrics, and Telecom's auto-unhold of a held non-emergency call after a new call fails in setup with code ERROR (CallsManagerCallSequencingAdapter.java:246-253); new non-emergency calls are aborted during an emergency call (CallsManager.java:2379-2392), so that cannot touch a held emergency call. Telecom's retry on a create failure ignores the code (CreateConnectionProcessor.java:643-653) and EmergencyStateTracker never reads the disconnect cause. On this build domain selection is off (config_domain_selection_service_component_name empty, no device overlay; DomainSelectionResolver.java:139-146), so the live emergency paths are the raw-code CS retry and door 1; doors 2-4 matter if 24.0 or a later overlay turns domain selection on. AOSP ImsStack: the extra message is the Reason header text (enrich flag true, carrier_config.xml:314; CallReasonInfo.h:325-354; Q.850 texts arrive as 'q.850;...'). A CANCEL already becomes 1014 for 'call completion elsewhere' or cause 200 and 1017 for 'another device sent all devices busy response' or cause 600/603 (CancelHandler.cpp:26-27, 62-86); a BYE saying 'call has been pulled by another device' already becomes 1016 (TerminationHandler.cpp). An emergency INVITE failure becomes CS retry 146 with an empty message by default, or 363/364 with an empty message, and a SIP code with Reason text only where the ImsStack's per-carrier emergency reject table says terminate (EmergencyStartErrorHandler.cpp:72-141). The ImsStack itself never reads this key (also on branch ocd).
findings.risk: The key is not display-only. A value whose target is 501 makes a failed emergency call look like a user hang-up and stops domain reselection (door 2); a target of 111 or 1500 (POWER_OFF) does the same. A target of 363/364 starts the other-slot redial, and an entry from 363/364 (for example '363||510', since an empty message matches all) removes it on the non-domain-selection path that this build uses (door 1). A target of 143, 1017 or 1404 lets INCOMING_REJECTED replace a user's LOCAL (door 3). A target of 1501 gives precise NO_VALID_SIM and ends emergency domain selection (door 4). The redial triggers themselves (146, 1514, 3001) read the raw code, so they cannot be mapped on or off.

notes: Hold: the key stays in group A. On this ROM and stack most mappings only change the shown reason, tone and call-log class, and every value in this round stays clear of the four doors. But a value that maps to or from 363/364, to 501, 111 or 1500, or to an INCOMING_REJECTED code would change whether a failed emergency call is redialed. A cheap guard for future values: proceed when no entry's FROM is 363, 364, 146, 1514 or 3001 (or '*' with a message those codes could carry) and no entry's TO is 501, 111, 1500, 1501, 143, 1017, 1404, 363, 364, 146, 1514 or 3001; read by hand otherwise (1017/1404 are in many real values and were read as safe here).
